title: 第17章 伪圣器当我侍女第18章 吹萧一曲
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: “徐墨，你在里面吗？我能进去嘛？”
柳如烟轻声问道。
“是烟儿，她怎么也来了！”
白昕儿心头巨震，下意识就想回房间躲起来。
毕竟，她可不想让柳如烟看到她如此狼狈的模样。
“进来。”
然而让她想不到的是，徐墨竟然开口答应了。
随着徐墨声音的落下，柳如烟推开圣子殿大门，紧接着就看到正在不远处站着的白昕儿。
“昕儿，你没事吧？”
柳如烟赶忙上前，焦急地问道。
“我没事。”
白昕儿俏脸微红，声音有些颤抖，低着头不敢看柳如烟的眼睛。
“真的没事吗？”
柳如烟神色有些担忧，她总觉得白昕儿变得有些不对，至于哪里不对。
好像比之前更漂亮，更有韵味了！
等等，这感觉莫非是！
柳如烟似乎想到了什么，她伸出玉手碰白昕儿，这一碰不要紧，直接让她面色一呆。
“昕儿，你的元阴，怎么也丢了！”
唉，真是欲哭无泪啊！
白昕儿还依稀记得，这句话她刚刚八卦跟柳如烟说完！
结果现在却成了柳如烟对她说了！
见白昕儿不说话，只是低着头抽泣，柳如烟强压怒火，瞪着徐墨，“徐墨，你对昕儿干了什么！”
徐墨今天心情不错，并没有因为她的怒视而恼怒，面色淡然。
“我对她干什么了，你应该也知道的吧？”
“你太过分了！
祸害我一个还不够，竟然把昕儿也给！”
柳如烟面色通红，差点要气炸了。
她实在想不通，为什么昕儿会与这个混蛋双修。
徐墨一听，顿时不乐意了，“啥叫祸害？
你别在这血口喷人，我和昕儿之间明明是两相情愿，何来祸害之说。
你要是不信，就自己问问她！”
话音刚落，徐墨瞥了一眼白昕儿，其意思自然不言而喻。
白昕儿见此，轻叹了口气，最终还是小声说道，“烟儿，圣子说得对。
我和圣子大人确实是两相情愿！”
content_en:
"Xu Mo, are you inside? Can I go in?"
Liu Ruyan asked softly.
"It's Yan'er, why is she here too!"
Bai Xin'er was shocked and subconsciously wanted to go back to the room and hide.
After all, she didn't want Liu Ruyan to see her in such a mess.
"Come in."
However, what she didn't expect was that Xu Mo actually agreed.
As Xu Mo's voice fell, Liu Ruyan pushed open the door of the Holy Child Hall, and then saw Bai Xin'er standing not far away.
"Xin'er, are you okay?"
Liu Ruyan hurried forward and asked anxiously.
"I'm fine."
Bai Xin'er's face was slightly red, her voice was trembling, and she lowered her head, not daring to look into Liu Ruyan's eyes.
"Is it really okay?"
Liu Ruyan looked a little worried. She always felt that something was wrong with Bai Xin'er. As for what was wrong.
It seems more beautiful and more charming than before!
Wait, this feels like it!
Liu Ruyan seemed to have thought of something. She stretched out her jade hand to touch Bai Xin'er. The touch didn't matter, it made her look stunned.
"Xin'er, your Yuan Yin has been lost!"
Alas, I really feel like crying without tears!
Bai Xin'er still vaguely remembered that she had just finished telling Liu Ruyan this sentence!
But now it was Liu Ruyan who told her!
Seeing that Bai Xin'er didn't speak, just lowered her head and sobbed, Liu Ruyan suppressed her anger and glared at Xu Mo, "Xu Mo, what did you do to Xin'er!"
Xu Mo was in a good mood today. He was not annoyed by her glare and looked calm.
"You should also know what I did to her, right?"
"You've gone too far!
It's not enough to harm me alone, but Xin'er is also harmed! "
Liu Ruyan's face turned red and she almost exploded with anger.
She really couldn't figure out why Xin'er would practice double cultivation with this bastard.
When Xu Mo heard this, he immediately became unhappy, "What do you mean by disaster?
Don't slander me like this. Xin'er and I are obviously consensual, so why should we talk about harm?
If you don’t believe it, ask her yourself! "
As soon as he finished speaking, Xu Mo glanced at Bai Xin'er, and the meaning was naturally self-evident.
Seeing this, Bai Xin'er sighed lightly, and finally whispered, "Yan'er, the Holy Son is right.
Lord Holy Son and I are indeed mutually consensual! "
